name: Shah Alam II
contribution: The seventeenth Mughal emperor and the son of Alamgir II.

checks.lead: Shah Alam II (Persian: شاه عالم دوم, Persian pronunciation: [ʃɑːh ʔɑː.ˈlam]; 25 June 1728 – 19 November 1806), also known by his birth name Ali Gohar, or Ali Gauhar, was the seventeenth Mughal emperor and the son of Alamgir II.
